Working with AI Clients

A comprehensive guide to using Nexus with different AI clients and editors.

Supported Clients​

ClientMCP SupportSetup Method
Claude CodeNativeCLI or manual
Claude DesktopNativeManual config
CursorNativeCLI or manual
VS CodeVia extensionExtension config
OpenCodeNativeManual config
ZedNativeSettings file
ContinueVia extensionExtension config

Claude Code​

Claude Code has the best MCP integration with a single command setup.

Quick Setup​

Claude Code setup
claude mcp add nexus -- npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcp-remote https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse

✓ Added MCP server nexus

Verify​

List MCP servers
claude mcp list

nexus (connected)

Remove​

claude mcp remove nexus

Claude Desktop​

Config Location​

OSPath
macOS~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
Windows%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
Linux~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json

Configuration​

claude_desktop_config.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    }
  }
}

Tips​

  • Restart required after config changes
  • Check the MCP icon in the bottom-left to see connected servers
  • Use "Developer Mode" in settings for debugging

Cursor​

Cursor uses a .cursor/mcp.json file.

Global Config​

# Location
~/.cursor/mcp.json

Project Config​

# In project root
.cursor/mcp.json

Configuration​

.cursor/mcp.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    }
  }
}

Tips​

  • Project config overrides global config
  • Restart Cursor after changes
  • Check the Composer panel for MCP status

VS Code​

VS Code requires an MCP extension.

Recommended Extensions​

  1. Anthropic MCP - Official Anthropic extension
  2. Continue - AI coding assistant with MCP support

Configuration​

settings.json
{
  "mcp.servers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    }
  }
}

Workspace Settings​

For project-specific config, use .vscode/settings.json:

.vscode/settings.json
{
  "mcp.servers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    }
  }
}

Zed​

Zed has native MCP support in recent versions.

Configuration​

~/.config/zed/settings.json
{
  "context_servers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    }
  }
}

OpenCode​

OpenCode supports MCP via its config file.

Configuration​

mcp.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    }
  }
}

Or in opencode.json:

opencode.json
{
  "mcp": {
    "nexus": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse",
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}

Local Server Mode​

All clients support running Nexus locally instead of using the remote server.

Benefits​

  • Offline access - Works without internet
  • Privacy - Data stays local
  • Custom libraries - Index your own docs
  • Lower latency - No network round trip

Configuration​

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@nexus/cli", "serve"]
    }
  }
}

Pre-installed CLI​

If you have the CLI installed globally:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "command": "nexus",
      "args": ["serve"]
    }
  }
}

Troubleshooting​

Connection Issues​

  1. Check URL: Must be https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse
  2. Firewall: Allow outbound HTTPS
  3. Proxy: Configure proxy settings if needed
  4. VPN: Some VPNs block SSE connections

Tools Not Appearing​

  1. Restart: Fully restart the client
  2. Wait: MCP connections take a few seconds
  3. Check logs: Look for connection errors

Rate Limiting​

Authenticate for higher limits:

Login
npx @nexus/cli auth login

✓ Authenticated as user@example.com

SSE Not Supported​

Some clients don't support Server-Sent Events. Use local mode:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@nexus/cli", "serve"]
    }
  }
}

Best Practices​

Use Project-Specific Memory​

Tell your AI which project you're working on:

"I'm working on the my-app project. Load the context."

Combine with Other MCP Servers​

Nexus works alongside other MCP servers:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    },
    "postgres": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres"]
    },
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx", 
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/path/to/project"]
    }
  }
}

Keep Configs in Sync​

Use the CLI to configure all your editors at once:

Configure all editors
npx @nexus/cli init

Select your editors:
  ✓ Claude Code
  ✓ Cursor
  ✓ VS Code

✓ Configured 3 editor(s)
